title: Presets
description:
An exercise in building instruments commonly heard across different genres, all created in Phaseplant using oscillators, filtering, envelopes, and effects, with macros assigned throughout. The process mirrors what you'd go through putting together a preset pack for distribution. 

I dropped each instrument over a basic drum loop to give them some context. The first batch gave me bomb defusal vibes, the second felt like playing Tetris in space. You'll find both tracks below alongside their individual instruments.

audio.label: Mix 1 - Bomb Defusal
audio.desc: All the instruments from the bomb defusal track combined. The drums are a standard Ableton sample loop.

audio.label: 808 Bass
audio.desc: A classic 808 bass. The mod wheel adds a transient click to the attack for extra customization.

audio.label: FM Pluck
audio.desc: Built using FM synthesis. Velocity controls how much FM is applied, while the mod wheel drives the amount of distortion on a percussive envelope.

audio.label: KG Lead
audio.desc: A lead made famous by a Kool & the Gang track. Overdrive, delay, and a trace gate were added on top. The gate toggles in the second half via MIDI automation.

audio.label: Wavetable Pad
audio.desc: Built from two wavetables, each with its own LFO modulating volume and wavetable frame at different rates to keep it moving. The mod wheel is tied to filter cutoff.

audio.label: Mix 2 - Space Tetris
audio.desc: All the instruments from the space tetris track combined. The drums are a standard Ableton sample loop.

audio.label: FM Bass
audio.desc: FM-based bass where a percussive envelope adds FM to the carrier. The mod wheel throws in a quick pitch shift transient for extra punch.

audio.label: Wavetable Bell Pluck
audio.desc: Two wavetables with random LFOs modulating each frame. The mod wheel controls filter cutoff and each wavetable's detune.

audio.label: Theremin Lead
audio.desc: Built to mimic a theremin. Composed of just an oscillator, overdrive, filter, and some modulation. The mod wheel controls LFO-driven pitch shift amount. Velocity is tied to filter cutoff.

audio.label: Layered Pad
audio.desc: An analog oscillator layered over a xylophone sample, with distortion and filtering applied to each independently. A modulator envelope rides the distortion drive on the analog oscillator.
